title: AI Job-Search & Application Platform
tagline: Semantic job matching and GPT-tailored resumes
summary: An AI job-search platform that ingests listings daily, enriches them with OpenAI, matches jobs semantically with pgvector, and generates job-specific resumes as PDFs.
overview: An AI job-search and application platform on Django and Google Cloud. It ingests job listings every day from an external data provider, enriches them with OpenAI batch jobs, and matches them to users with vector search in PostgreSQL.

Users upload a resume, which is parsed with PyMuPDF and GPT, and the platform generates resumes and cover letters tailored to each job, tracks applications, and powers a Chrome extension that applies automatically. I was the main backend contributor during the later phase of the project.
